messages.text: I’d like you to turn this pic of me into a professional headshot, with just a bit of tidying rather than a whole new look. I always feel a little nervous about edited portraits because I still want to recognise myself when I see the finished image. What matters most, somewhere in all of that, is that you keep my face recognisably me and don’t make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. It’s really just the lighting, outfit and background that I’d like you to tidy up. I’m hoping this will feel like a more polished version of the photo rather than make me feel like I’m looking at somebody else.

Keep her face exactly the same: identical facial features, face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, eyebrows, expression and age. Keep her natural skin texture and pores; do not smooth, retouch or make her look younger. Keep her dark curly shoulder-length hair as it is. Only change three things: replace the park background with a plain, softly blurred neutral grey studio backdrop; give her a simple tailored dark navy blazer over a plain crew-neck top in place of the grey sweater; use soft, even, flattering studio lighting on the face. Same framing, same head position, photorealistic, no text.
